rotor_blade_count.quote: The rotor has 48 blades, the tip solidity is 1.3, and the aspect ratio is 1.63.

stator_blade_count.quote: The stator has 62 blades, the tip solidity is 1.3, and the aspect ratio is 1.78.

profile_type.quote: Both the rotor and the stator have multiple-circular-arc (MCA) blade shapes.

design_stage_pressure_ratio.quote: The stage was designed for a total-pressure ratio of 1.82, an airflow of 20.2 kilograms per second, and a rotor tip speed of 455 meters per second.

design_mass_flow.quote: an airflow of 20.2 kilograms per second

design_tip_speed.quote: a rotor tip speed of 455 meters per second

tip_clearance_cold.quote: The nominal nonrotating tip clearance was 0.071 centimeter.

tip_clearance_running_estimated.quote: On the basis of the calculated growths of the blade and disk, it is estimated that the running clearance will be 0.018 centimeter at design conditions.

rotor_tmax_over_c_tip.quote: The tip values are 3.2 percent for rotors 35 and 37 and 3.6 percent for rotors 36 and 36. [sic]

flowpath_same_all_four_stages.quote: The flow path geometry for all four stages is the same, and the coordinates are given in figure 1. The rotor and stator leading- and trailing-edge locations are shown in figure l(a) for stages 35 and 37 and in figure l(b) for stages 36 and 38.

profile_definition.value: MCA (multiple circular arc), conical blade-element surface
profile_definition.quote: Multiple circular arc (MCA) blade profiles were used in the design of all blade rows to accomplish these objectives. The development of the MCA blade profile is discussed in detail in reference 4. The blade elements are defined on an upwrapped conical surface which approximates a surface of revolution generated by revolving the flow streamline about the compressor axis (fig. 8). Blade-element meanline and surfaces are defined based on a constant rate of angle change with path distance (fig.9). The blade meanline and surfaces have two segments.

profile_parameters.value: meanline angles at inlet, transition, outlet; max thickness; LE and TE thicknesses; locations of max thickness and transition point
profile_parameters.quote: The blade shape is specified by meanline angles at inlet, transition, and outlet and by maximum thickness, leading- and trailing-edge thicknesses, and the locations of maximum thickness and transition points. After the blade-element coordinates are defined, these elements are stacked about their centers of area along a prescribed stacking line.

manufacturing_section_plane.value: plane normal to a radial line; coordinates in inches (Appendix C)
manufacturing_section_plane.quote: For manufacturing purposes blade section coordinates are provided on a plane x-y coordinate system normal to a radial line as shown in figure 10.

rotor_deviation_rule.quote: The deviation angles were calculated based on a modified Carter's rule.

rotor_tmax_over_c_hub.quote: The maximum thickness to chord ratio for all four rotors is 8 percent at the hub (fig. 13(g)).

rotor_tmax_location_fraction_chord.quote: The locations of maximum thickness as a fraction of chord are 0.68 at the tip and approximately 0.52 at the hub (fig. 13(h)).

design_mass_flow_text.quote: All four stages were designed for a mass flow of 20.20 kilograms per second and a rotor tip speed of 455 meters per second.

Z_reference.quote: Z axial distance referenced from rotor-blade-hub leading edge, cm (Appendix A, performance report)

angle_convention_KIC.value: angle between blade mean camber line at leading edge and meridional plane, deg
angle_convention_KIC.quote: KIC angle between blade mean camber line at leading edge and meridional plane, deg (Appendix C, performance report)

cone_angle_definition.value: angle between axial direction and conical surface representing blade element
cone_angle_definition.quote: CONE ANGLE angle between axial direction and conical surface representing blade element, deg (Appendix C, performance report)

percent_span_definition.value: percent of blade span from tip at rotor outlet
percent_span_definition.quote: PERCENT SPAN percent of blade span from tip at rotor outlet (Appendix C, TP-1338)

measurement_stations.value: station 1 upstream of rotor; station 3 downstream of stator; no measurement between rotor and stator; station-2 values translated from station 3 along design streamlines
measurement_stations.quote: Because of the close spacing between the rotor and stator, no measurements were made between the rotor and stator. At station 3 (downstream of stator) two combination probes and two wedge probes were traversed both circumferentially and radially
